title: Machines for the computation phases
statement: Let $P$ and $Q$ be deterministic $k$-work-tape Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with state types $S_P$ and $S_Q$, and choose a work tape $j$. The phase-indexed nondeterministic machines are respectively $P$ with its transition independent of the choice bit; a bounded writer that writes the chosen Boolean on tape $j$ until it encounters a blank and then halts; a rightward scan of tape $j$ until a blank is found; the specified rewind scan of tape $j$; $Q$ with its transition independent of the choice bit; and a machine that halts after emitting the chosen Boolean.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a deterministic machine over Booleans with state type $S_P$
$j$ is one of the $k$ work tapes
$Q$ is a deterministic machine over Booleans with state type $S_Q$
